name: Swarms
rootCause: The AI agent protocol Swarms disclosed on the X platform that its community Discord account had been compromised. Earlier today, a team member’s Discord account was breached after receiving a malicious direct message from a user. As a result, the attacker deleted several channels and removed over 300 community members.
